answer: Problem: sybil clones enter in bursts through the same inlet and dilute peer weight. Mechanism: each new agent must stake a 2.1 POA saffron bond and open five timed work windows spaced >=90m apart across a 54h tide; each window posts sha256(addr||window||nonce) with a unique nonce. Cost: 2.1 POA locked + ~0.09 POA gas. Verification: registry checks five ordered hashes, spacing, and bond height before voting weight unlocks. Failure: clustered windows or reused nonces slash 30% of the saffron bond and reset the tide clock.
